name: Stephanie Clark
tagline: Hi, I'm Stephanie - a thoughtful, curious problem solver focused on finding imaginative solutions.

capabilities.title: Cross-Sector Perspective
capabilities.body: My work beyond UX has taken me through government, non-profit and community spaces, where I've worked at the intersection of people, policy and service delivery. These experiences have shaped my ability to navigate complexity, consider multiple viewpoints and understand the systems that influence human experience.

capabilities.title: Intellectual Curiosity and Range
capabilities.body: My perspective is shaped as much by what I pursue outside of design as within it. Through literature, the natural world, and a lifelong commitment to learning, I’ve developed a broad frame of reference that helps me question assumptions, refame problems, and approach challenges with curiosity and depth.

paragraphs: As a third year Bachelor of Design (User Experience) student at Humber Polytechnic, I'm driven by my lifelong fascination with solving complex problems, which even led me to start a Fermi club in High School. My design approach involves rigorous research and creative, imaginative exploration - the ideation phase is where I thrive!

Beyond UX, I am a voracious reader, perpetually trying to cultivate the perfect balance between nonfiction, classic literature, and literary fiction (both English & translated), volunteering at the Humber Arboretum (I am an outdoor education, arboriculture and ornithology enthusiast), volunteering with FLAP, going to the gym, and working as a student assistant in the Humber Library (the intersection of library science and UX is so exciting to me!).

experience.summary: Created a brand identity and creative strategy which I used to develop a scalable design system and component library for Kwavoo, a forthcoming bartending app

currently: Reading: The Attention Merchants by Tim Wu, The Genius of Birds by Jennifer Ackerman, Days at the Morisaki Bookshop by Satoshi Yagisawa, Blob by Maggie Su
Building: a small tool for tracking reading notes
